clips.title: The story
paras: On Brightwater Lake, Gunther Arcanus keeps an enchanted candle for a summons. Light it on a nearby islet, and the restless spirit Lillith Nefara answers.

Gunther Arcanus keeps the Candle of Beckoning in a crate beside him on his island in Brightwater Lake. The candle is an instrument for a ritual of summoning. Gunther is a fiercely independent undead sorcerer who broke free of the Lich King's command on his own, and he remains wary of both the Scourge and the Forsaken. To show Gunther that you are not loyal to the Lich King, carry one of the candles southwest to a smaller islet. Set it on an old, bloodstained table and light it. The flame pierces the veil between worlds and beckons the dormant, restless shade of Lillith Nefara, a powerful Scourge agent, so she can be destroyed.
